instances.claim: This tells me that Chang issued a bounded set of cent-objects — identical when they left him — into the hands of participants who have been handling them over time.
instances.why: Line 19's 'Each object, initially identical' is a claim about a population with fixed membership, and nothing earlier introduces such a collection: line 5 names a single chosen readymade, line 6 names the 500 billion coins the US Mint struck (not objects of Chang's that could 'bear the marks of touch and time'), and line 11 asserts transformations of value rather than a set of held things. Line 20 then refers to 'its participants' as already known, so the two lines together imply a distribution step — objects given out, identical at issue, now marked by handling — that the draft never states.
